Microprocessor-based neonatal radiant warmer with servo and manual temperature control.

MEDIRAY 05+ Phototherapy Unit

The system is engineered for high compatibility with a wide range of hospital bassinets, cribs, infant warmers, and incubators, enabling quick positioning and stable installation without modification to existing NICU infrastructure. Its optimized optical design ensures uniform light distribution across the treatment area, allowing effective phototherapy without obstructing patient access.

MEDIRAY supports continuous, uninterrupted phototherapy, while permitting real-time patient monitoring, routine nursing care, and concurrent medical interventions. The non-contact, low-heat LED system minimizes thermal stress and reduces the need for repositioning, making it highly efficient for use in high-acuity neonatal environments where safety, consistency, and workflow efficiency are critical.

product_name_source: Compact syringe infusion pump for neonatal, paediatric and adult patients.
short_description: User-friendly syringe pump supporting 5 ml to 50 ml syringes with advanced infusion safety functions.
technical_specifications: Syringe sizes: 5-50 ml; anti-bolus mechanism; pressure limit control up to 900 mmHg; KVO mode; power consumption 7 W; weight 1.75 kg; corner status LED visible from 30 feet; IPX4 protection; multiple porting.
detailed_description:
SYRU 4004 Basic is a compact syringe infusion pump for neonatal, paediatric and adult use. It supports 5 ml to 50 ml syringes and multiple-port configurations for easier transport and setup across care settings.

Safety and operating features include an anti-bolus mechanism, adjustable pressure-limit control up to 900 mmHg, Keep Vein Open mode after infusion, corner LED status indication visible from long range, quick start, high accuracy, safety alarms, an easy-carry handle and robust construction. The catalogue specifies 7 W power consumption, 1.75 kg weight and IPX4 protection.

product_name_source: Advanced compact syringe pump with dynamic pressure monitoring.
short_description: Advanced 5-50 ml syringe pump with dynamic pressure display, anti-bolus protection and KVO mode.
technical_specifications: Syringe sizes: 5-50 ml; anti-bolus mechanism; pressure control up to 900 mmHg; dynamic running-pressure display with occlusion bar indicator; KVO mode; 7 W power consumption; IPX4; corner LED; multiple porting.
detailed_description:
SYRU 4004 Advance expands the 4004 platform with a dynamic running-pressure display and bar indication for occlusion monitoring. It accepts 5 ml to 50 ml syringes for neonatal, paediatric and adult infusion.

The pump includes anti-bolus protection, pressure-limit control up to 900 mmHg, KVO after infusion, multiple porting, long-distance corner LED status indication, quick start, prime-on-the-go controls, alarms, an easy-carry handle and a robust IPX4-protected enclosure. Power consumption is listed as 7 W.

product_name_source: Multipurpose syringe infusion pump with dose-rate functions and neonatal syringe support.
short_description: Multipurpose syringe pump supporting 2-50 ml syringes, drug-dose operation and patient-controlled analgesia.
technical_specifications: Syringe sizes: 2-50 ml; minimum flow rate from 0.01 ml/hr; IPX4 water resistance; dynamic pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar; anti-bolus; pressure limit up to 900 mmHg; KVO; approximately 7 W power consumption; RS232 connectivity; PCA and drug-library functions.
detailed_description:
Terumax Rx is a multipurpose syringe pump designed for critical care, neonatal and anaesthetic applications. Its 2 ml syringe compatibility and flow rates beginning at 0.01 ml/hr support low-volume infusion. Drug-dose operation uses patient weight, drug concentration and dosage inputs, and the product supports patient-controlled analgesia.

The pump provides long-view LED and detailed LCD information, RS232 connectivity, anti-bolus and KVO functions, pressure-limit control up to 900 mmHg, and dynamic pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar. The enclosure is IPX4 water resistant and made from rugged ABS plastic designed to withstand drops.

product_name_source: Advanced syringe pump with drug library and wireless upgrade support.
short_description: Advanced syringe pump with a 2,000-drug library, dynamic pressure display and low-light status LEDs.
technical_specifications: Drug library: approximately 2,000 drugs with multiple dose units; Wi-Fi upgradable; dynamic pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar; 3.1-inch LCD and seven-segment display; strip and corner LEDs; purge and automatic bolus; post-occlusion bolus reduction; IPX4; 10 programming modes.
detailed_description:
SYRU 6006 is an advanced syringe pump with a drug library for approximately 2,000 drugs and dose units including mg, mcg, ng, cal and kcal. A violet vasopressor LED helps reduce high-risk drug identification errors.

Its 3.1-inch LCD, seven-segment display, strip LEDs and long-distance corner LED support visibility in dark ICUs. The pump offers purge bolus, hands-free automatic bolus, an adjustable maximum bolus limit, post-occlusion bolus reduction, dynamic pressure display, Wi-Fi upgrade capability, multiple porting, long battery operation, IPX4 protection and ten programming modes.

product_name_source: Premium compact syringe pump with colour display and multi-parameter layout.

technical_specifications: Weight: 1.65 kg; display: 2.4-inch bright TFT colour; simultaneous display of syringe size, rate, infused volume, remaining time and mode; Wi-Fi upgradable; vasopressor LED; dynamic pressure display; strip LED; IPX4; 10 programming modes.
detailed_description:
SYRU 8008 combines a compact 1.65 kg body with a 2.4-inch bright TFT colour display. Its multi-parameter layout shows syringe size, set rate, infused volume, remaining time and operating mode without screen switching.

The model includes a colour-coded violet vasopressor alert, Wi-Fi upgrade capability, dynamic running-pressure display in PSI, mmHg, kPa and bar, strip LED visibility, safety alarms, long battery operation, IPX4 protection and ten programming modes.

product_name_source: Volumetric infusion pump for adult and paediatric infusion using multiple IV-set types.
short_description: Wi-Fi-enabled volumetric infusion pump with external drop sensor and adult/micro IV-set compatibility.
technical_specifications: Adult and paediatric modes; compatible with adult and micro IV sets; external drop sensor; rate entry in drops/min or ml/hr; quick ml/hr setting; Wi-Fi enabled; standby mode; IPX4; intuitive LCD/LED interface.
detailed_description:
Infumax 5005 is a volumetric infusion pump designed for adult and paediatric infusions. Its external drop sensor supports accuracy across different IV-set brands, while adult and micro IV-set compatibility broadens clinical use.

The flow rate can be entered in drops per minute or ml/hr, with a quick ml/hr setting for emergencies. The interface combines organised controls, LED indicators and an LCD. Other listed features include Wi-Fi, standby mode, quick start, high accuracy, an easy-carry handle, robust construction and IPX4 protection.

product_name_search: WARMJET IV Blood and Fluid Warmer
short_description: DC-powered open-system fluid warmer supporting standard IV sets and warming rates up to 6 L/hr.
technical_specifications: Pure low-voltage DC heater; precision heat exchanger covering up to 70% of IV tubing; open-system compatibility with standard IV sets; smart idle mode; warms fluids up to 6 L/hr; Celsius/Fahrenheit display; shock-resistant portable design.
detailed_description:
WARMJET IV is a blood and fluid warmer designed for operating-theatre and emergency use. Its low-voltage DC heater removes AC power from the bedside heating circuit. A precision heat exchanger covers up to 70% of the IV tube to help limit temperature loss from airflow and ambient conditions.

The open system can be used with standard IV sets rather than dedicated consumables. Smart Idle Mode detects when therapy has not started after setup and alerts staff. The catalogue lists fluid warming up to 6 L/hr, Celsius/Fahrenheit display, a lightweight portable body and shock-resistant construction.

WARMJET II Plus is a compact blood and fluid warmer intended for ICU and prolonged low-flow infusion. Its universal heat exchanger is designed for major IV-set brands used in Indian hospitals. A door-style loading mechanism enables quick setup, while the door-open alarm stops therapy and alerts staff if the door is unsecured.

Pole-clamp and lanyard mounting support crowded ICU spaces. Dedicated heating paths accommodate small and medium IV sets, and an optional secondary heater provides dual heating for faster warm-up and improved temperature consistency. The catalogue lists warming up to 3 L/hr, Smart Idle Mode and a palm-sized, robust-hinge design.
